rules.statement: A donor may be regarded as having personally made a disposition of property by way of gift whenever the property effectually passes to the donee by an indirect process which was controlled at every stage by the donor himself.
rules.supporting_quote: "In this context they are not eiusdem generis with the forms of 'disposition' previously enumerated ; they indicate that a donor may also be regarded as having personally made a disposition of property by way of gift whenever the property effectually passes to the 'donee' by an indirect process which was controlled at every stage by the 'donor' himself."
